claims: The International Day of Happiness is observed annually on March 20.
The International Day of Happiness is a United Nations-established day.
The International Day of Happiness recognizes happiness and well-being as universal goals and priorities.
The International Day of Happiness promotes a "happiness for all" agenda.
2026 events for the International Day of Happiness focus on social media's impact and intentional offline connection.
The date of the International Day of Happiness is March 20th of every year.
The International Day of Happiness was established by the United Nations General Assembly in 2012.
The establishment of the International Day of Happiness followed a proposal from UN adviser Jayme Illien.
Jayme Illien's proposal was to promote a "happiness for all" agenda.
The 2026 focus of the International Day of Happiness is "Happiness and Social Media".
The 2026 focus of the International Day of Happiness explores how social media impacts well-being, especially for young people.
The 2026 focus of the International Day of Happiness encourages mindful use or breaks from social media.
The World Happiness Report is typically released around March 20.
